clues: This small city lies on the central plains of Manitoba in Canada. It sits west of Winnipeg.
In the warm months, no place in Canada gets more sunny days than this town. Its summers are the sunniest in the country.
The Assiniboine River flooded this town again and again for years. Those floods kept coming back and shaped its past.
A long road runs past this town and right across Canada. It sits half way between Saskatchewan and Ontario.
A man-made flood channel runs north from town to Lake Manitoba. It was built to carry river flood water safely away.
